settings.text: Everything we get asked most often. If yours is not here, write to us — a real person replies within two working days.

settings.question: When will my order be dispatched?
settings.answer: Within two working days. You will get a tracking link the moment it leaves the studio.

settings.question: How much is shipping?
settings.answer: Complimentary on orders over $150. Below that it is a flat rate calculated at checkout, and it is always carbon-offset at our cost.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, worldwide. Duties for orders outside the UK and EU are collected at checkout so nothing is owed on delivery.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel an order?
settings.answer: If it has not shipped, yes. Email your order number as soon as you can and we will catch it.

settings.question: What is the returns window?
settings.answer: Thirty days from delivery, unworn and with tags attached. Underwear and pierced jewellery are the only exceptions.

settings.question: How do I return something?
settings.answer: Use the label in your parcel, or request one from your account page. Refunds land on the original payment method within five working days of arrival.

settings.question: Can I exchange for another size?
settings.answer: Yes. Note the size you want on the returns slip and we will reserve it while your parcel is in transit.

settings.question: Are sale items returnable?
settings.answer: Everything except final-sale pieces, which are marked clearly on the product page.

settings.question: How do I choose a size?
settings.answer: Every product page lists flat garment measurements in centimetres, plus the height and size of the model. Compare against a piece you already own and love.

settings.question: I am between sizes — up or down?
settings.answer: Down in knitwear, up in outerwear. Shirting is cut generously, so most people take their usual size.

settings.question: Will it shrink?
settings.answer: Our natural fibres are pre-washed, so shrinkage is minimal if you follow the care label. Cold wash, dry flat, never tumble.

settings.question: Do you really repair for free?
settings.answer: Yes. Seams, buttons, zips, moth holes — for as long as you own the piece. You cover postage to us, we cover everything else.

settings.question: How should I wash knitwear?
settings.answer: Rarely. Air it between wears, spot-clean marks, and hand wash cool once or twice a season. Dry flat, away from radiators.

settings.question: What if a piece is beyond repair?
settings.answer: Send it back anyway. We take it apart for patch stock and offer you a credit towards a replacement.

settings.heading: Care and repairs
settings.text: Still stuck? Write to us and we will help.
